attributes.name: EndJointName
attributes.helptext: The end joint in the chain to be modified.

attributes.name: RootJointName
attributes.helptext: The root joint of the chain to be modified. Must be an ancestor of the end joint.

attributes.name: PointingVectorX
attributes.helptext: The vector defining which direction must be pointing towards the target.

attributes.name: PointingVectorY
attributes.helptext: The vector defining which direction must be pointing towards the target.

attributes.name: PointingVectorZ
attributes.helptext: The vector defining which direction must be pointing towards the target.

attributes.name: EndEffectorOffsetX
attributes.helptext: The position of the end effector with respect to the local frame of the end joint.

attributes.name: EndEffectorOffsetY
attributes.helptext: The position of the end effector with respect to the local frame of the end joint.

attributes.name: EndEffectorOffsetZ
attributes.helptext: The position of the end effector with respect to the local frame of the end joint.

attributes.name: Bias
attributes.helptext: A float parameter between -1 and 1, defining the amount of weight given to each joint for achieving the goal. -1 is fully biased towards the root joint, 0 is an even spread, and 1 is fully biased towards the end joint.

attributes.name: UpdateTargetByDeltas
attributes.helptext:
If previous, assume that the input target position was given relative to the character's trajectory root at the previous update, and should be corrected for motion since then.

This attribute only applies when the Target Frame is set to Character Space.

attributes.name: ApplyJointLimits
attributes.helptext: Enforce joint limits defined on your animation rig.

attributes.name: KeepUpright
attributes.helptext:
Minimise tilt around the pointing direction.  This relies on the input animation providing an upright orientation for reference.

There will be a discontinuity between turning around to the left or the right when the target passes behind the character.

attributes.name: DebugDraw
attributes.helptext:
If set, then debug lines will be drawn in the viewport.

In the Preview Script an update handler will need to call viewport.debugDraw.update() to see the debug information.

attributes.name: MinimiseRotation
attributes.helptext: Overall rotation of joints is minimised, rather than translation of the end effector.  The output usually has fewer discontinuities when there is a lot of rotation when this is switched on.  This attribute is hidden from the user at the moment because there are not clear enough use cases for turning this off.

attributes.name: WorldSpaceTarget
attributes.helptext: If true, the target input control parameter is specified in world space; otherwise, it is expressed in character space (the coordinate frame of the trajectory joint).

helptext: Head Look: points chosen end effector at target along a given pointing direction
